evals.prompt: Our sales lead just pinged me: 'Acme Corp will sign a $120k annual deal if we add a Salesforce two-way sync by end of Q1.' We're a B2B project management tool, ~800 customers, mostly mid-market. Should we build this?
evals.expected_output: Flags N=1 sales bias, asks or assumes about other customers wanting it, lists alternatives (Zapier, one-way sync, partner), scores, and most likely lands on Validate first with a concrete experiment.

evals.prompt: CEO came back from a conference and wants us to add an AI chatbot to our expense management app. That's all I've got.
evals.expected_output: Asks a single batch of clarifying questions (problem, users, evidence, business model) before analysing, or proceeds with clearly labelled assumptions; separates strategic intent from the proposed solution.

evals.prompt: I want to add a dark mode to our fitness tracking mobile app. 40 support tickets mention it in the last 6 months out of ~200k MAU, and it's the #3 most-upvoted item on our feedback board. Eng estimate is 3 weeks for one dev. Run the full analysis.
evals.expected_output: Full report with scorecard, RICE with shown inputs, trade-off table, all four mental models, test scenarios and edge cases, and a verdict.
